data.title: 夏洛特 · 宿舍沙发的解扣娇羞
data.description: 学园宿舍温暖的客厅内，夏洛特侧坐在毛绒地毯与沙发旁。米白色的法式针织衫松垮落肩，浅金色的长马尾垂落在雪白锁骨间。平时温和体贴的法国少女此刻双颊泛起动人红晕，双手轻轻交叠在胸前，微低着头抬眸凝望，眼神中溢满了初恋般的青涩悸动与私密期待。
data.location: dim cozy student dormitory living room
data.action: sitting on soft carpet leaning on sofa, off-shoulder cream knit sweater exposing shoulder and collarbone, blonde ponytail draped over chest, blushing heavily, bashful affectionate gaze
data.lighting: warm interior chandelier glow creating cozy golden reflections
data.mood: innocent fluttering heartbeat, sweet french elegance
data.promptProse: Sitting on the carpet leaning gently against a sofa, Charlotte wears an off-shoulder cream knit sweater that reveals her collarbone. Her blonde ponytail rests against her chest as she looks up with an adorable, blushing gaze.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte sitting by a couch in an off-shoulder sweater, blushing with bashful affection.
